decision.reason: The only evidence, a CLI changelog line [ev-2a1f31a924a0], says that source-watcher was updated to v2.0.1. It gives no image repository, no previous version and no effect, so the bare name "source-watcher" in image-in-use cannot be confirmed as the identity an engine would match. The validators found source-watcher in neither release's manifests, refuted the tag change because the image is not referenced on both sides, and could not render the chart. Without the image repository and confirmation that the release manifests ship source-watcher, the exposure condition can be neither confirmed nor corrected.
